description: Find the organization ID the app already sends, so accounts can be created from existing data without code. Looks at event properties from the last 180 days and contact attributes named like workspaceId, organization_id, team_id or account_id. Each candidate has source (event or attribute), propertyKey, nameKey (a sibling name property or null), eventCount (events for event, contacts for attribute), accountCount (distinct organizations) and eventNames. Read-only; next, preview a candidate with preview_accounts_from_organization_id and show it to the user.

companyId.description: Company ID. If not provided, uses the currently selected company.
